task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be great if you could venture east. And then, go to the east. Then, attempt to go east. And then, make an effort to move north. Then, head north. After that, make an effort to go to the north. Then, venture north. After that, venture east. After that, attempt to take a trip south. And then, head west. Following that, travel south. Then, try to go south. After that, venture south. Once you succeed at that, attempt to venture south. After that, head south. That done, attempt to venture east. With that done, travel north. With that over with, move west. And then, move west. Then, try to go to the south. With that done, go to the south. With that done, move south. With that accomplished, attempt to venture east. Then, try to take a trip south. Okay, and then, make an attempt to take a trip west. With that over with, go north. Next, try to take a trip east. Next, take a trip north. Okay, and then, venture west. After that, move west. Once you get around to doing that, make an attempt to travel west. With that accomplished, make an attempt to venture south. And then, try to travel west. And then, head west. With that over with, make an attempt to take a trip north. With that accomplished, try to travel east. And then, try to venture north. If you can manage that, travel west. Okay, and then, venture south. With that over with, make an attempt to move east. And then, go to the east. And then, attempt to move north. After that, make an effort to move north. That done, head east. Then, travel north. If you can do that, make an effort to take a trip east. Then, move east. And then, take a trip east. Once you accomplish that, go to the south. Following that, go west. After that, try to go west. Then, attempt to travel south. Following that, make an attempt to go to the west. Then, make an effort to venture south. After that, venture east. Following that, try to take a trip north. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. After that, attempt to take a trip north. If you can do that, move east. After that, go to the east. And then, attempt to go east. With that accomplished, attempt to head east. Then, travel north. Following that, make an attempt to go north. Then, take a trip north. And then, move north. After that, make an effort to take a trip north. And then, move north. Following that, try to venture east. Following that, recover the coin from the floor of the dish-pit. And if you do that, you're the winner!
